checks.evidence: ScientificModel.expressionLanguage matches AST language_id; ast_version remains a separate serialization schema version.
Resource Graph supports expression nodes and fixture includes Model->Expression dependency edges.
Runtime Execution enum aligned to R03.15 authoritative states; worker phases are not persisted execution states.
AST and Unit Registry use four-axis dimension vectors.
Three representative event types have registry, schema and fixture mapping; full event catalog not complete.
Eight command payload mappings exist; resource authorization and state transition policy not fully bound.
Package Manifest to Resource Graph and Canonical Projection generator not implemented.
JCS and CBOR single-runner candidate repeatability passed; cross-language golden vectors and production profile selection absent.
Schemas and static trust/license policy tests exist; cryptographic verification, KMS/HSM and legal review absent.
SQLite delivery harness and PostgreSQL RLS/transaction tests pass separately; no real Broker end-to-end test.
JWT claims and cursor HMAC tests exist; JWT signature/JWKS, real middleware and distributed rate limit absent.
DC/RC reference numerical tests pass; no production solver, adaptive/stiff solver or cross-platform regression.
Scene/Timeline/Instrument schemas and static graph checks pass; no renderer or real instrument pipeline.
R03.33-R03.43 static and test harnesses are wired into GitHub Actions; actual Run IDs are recorded in R03.23.

findings.title: Package Manifest → Resource Graph → Canonical Digest自动投影缺失
findings.impact: 资源引用、依赖闭包和Digest目前由独立Fixture验证，发布时无法证明实际Package内容被完整纳入摘要。
findings.required_action: 实现只读Package Projection Builder；从Package Schema/Model/Scene/Instrument/Expression/Assets生成Graph和Canonical Projection，并对真实完整Package做闭包与Digest Golden Vector。

findings.title: DEC-27/28/29供应链信任链未闭环
findings.impact: 生产Digest profile、真实签名验签、密钥撤销/轮换、Provenance可信构建和许可法律证据均未完成。
findings.required_action: 完成跨语言Canonicalization Spike、密码学签名/Trust Registry/KMS Spike、SPDX解析和法律/内容治理审查；在此之前禁止声称Package可安全签名发布。

findings.title: Tenant Context GUC不是抗攻陷凭证的安全边界
findings.impact: 持有应用数据库凭证的主体可自行设置自定义GUC；RLS只能补漏过滤，不能独立抵御任意SQL。
findings.required_action: 评估每Tenant DB role、受信SECURITY DEFINER上下文或独立数据库；完成威胁建模、权限审计和跨Tenant渗透测试。

findings.title: 事件目录与真实Broker/Consumer集成不完整
findings.impact: Registry只覆盖三个代表事件；SQLite/PostgreSQL Harness彼此独立，不能证明真实Broker Ack/Redelivery/Ordering/DLQ。
findings.required_action: 补齐全量Event Catalog、Consumer compatibility/upcaster矩阵，并在选定Broker上执行多进程故障注入和端到端测试。

findings.title: ScientificModel到Typed Expression/Quantity Registry仍缺少自动绑定验证
findings.impact: AST Fixture使用独立symbol_table，未从真实Model Variable/Parameter Registry解析所有符号并验证目标Quantity Kind。
findings.required_action: 实现Model Expression Binding Validator，逐Equation加载Expression Resource，解析变量注册表、Unit Registry和expected target quantity kind。

findings.title: 生产Simulation Runtime与Worker尚未实现
findings.impact: Lease/Fencing/Checkpoint/Recovery/Quota目前只有契约和静态验证，不能保证运行期取消、资源隔离和迟到结果防护。
findings.required_action: 在产品代码冻结解除后，以独立Worker Spike实现Lease/Fencing/Checkpoint故障注入；此前不进入产品功能实现。

findings.title: 生产Solver与数值验证体系尚未建立
findings.impact: Euler/RK4测试参考器不覆盖刚性ODE、自适应步长、事件定位、DAE/PDE、跨平台浮点差异。
findings.required_action: 先完成Solver Adapter与数值误差规范，再进行候选Solver Spike和DC/RC真实模型回归。

findings.title: Renderer/Instrument没有真实端到端数据链
findings.impact: Scene/Timeline/Instrument契约没有真实Renderer、Interaction Command和Observation采样实现。
findings.required_action: 产品冻结解除后选择Renderer候选并完成Simulation Time同步、仪表采样和Interaction到Command的集成验证。

findings.title: API JWT/JWKS、Retry-After与分布式限流未验证
findings.impact: 现有测试只验证Claims和Cursor HMAC；未验证签名、真实Middleware、限流窗口和客户端重试。
findings.required_action: 完成OIDC/JWKS集成、资源级授权测试、并发幂等和分布式Rate Limit测试。

findings.title: Unit Registry和Quantity Kind覆盖不完整
findings.impact: 当前SI Registry仅覆盖有限基础/派生单位；偏移单位、复合单位和领域Quantity Kind未形成完整治理。
findings.required_action: 建立经科学审查的Unit Registry版本、Canonical Unit映射、转换精度与offset运算规则。

findings.title: 跨模块Schema版本/兼容性仍依赖人工协调
findings.impact: Package、Model、AST、Event、Command和Renderer Schema缺少统一兼容性矩阵及自动生成的变更影响分析。
findings.required_action: 建立Schema Catalog、兼容性规则、Consumer contract matrix和CI breaking-change gate。

findings.title: Product R02冻结条件未满足
findings.impact: 用户研究、科学专家签核和试点客户均未完成；不能据技术契约通过宣称产品Ready。
findings.required_action: 继续产品代码冻结；先完成研究、专家评审、试点和产品冻结审计。

readiness.next_gate: R03.44 findings remediation plan + R03.45 Contract Integration/Projection Builder design; no product feature implementation
